failure.summary: 24 of 92 Playwright design-system browser-visual tests failed on the real Windows GitHub Actions runner (windows-latest, first-ever run of this workflow -- 0 prior runs existed). Every single failure is a toHaveScreenshot() pixel-diff mismatch against a checked-in `*-win32.png` baseline; zero failures are Go/build/compile/lint errors, zero are test crashes or timeouts, and 68 of the 92 tests (including every non-visual-comparison assertion, all calibration tests, and several toHaveScreenshot() comparisons -- Guided First Show x4, Desk/Operator Surface x4, dialog layer x4) passed cleanly.

artifactInspection.method: Downloaded the single design-system-visual-evidence artifact (id 8877908319) via `gh run download 30870575466` into a temporary contained directory, visually inspected a sample of *-diff.png images (small-diff case: scenes-looks-light-900; large-diff cases: midi-mapping-dark-1280, shared-gallery-dark-1280), computed sha256/byteCount for every one of the 24 failing tests' -actual.png and -diff.png files, then deleted the temporary directory.
artifactInspection.smallDiffObservation: In the small-diff cases (Scenes & Looks, Fixture Library/Patch & Pools, Scripts/Notes, persistent shell -- 15 to 805 pixels, ratio 0.01), the diff overlay shows isolated red marks confined to small icon-like glyphs (e.g. panel-header expand/collapse chevrons), with the rest of the page rendering pixel-identical (faded/white in the diff overlay).
artifactInspection.largeDiffObservation: In the large-diff cases (MIDI Mapping, shared gallery -- 13274 to 28192 pixels, ratio 0.02-0.05), the diff overlay shows the SAME text content duplicated at two slightly different vertical (and occasionally horizontal) positions across the entire page -- e.g. 'No Desk mappings yet', 'Warm Wash scene', 'Blackout Fade scene' in MIDI Mapping, and 'Nothing here yet', 'Create an item to begin', 'Guided flow and selected state' in the shared gallery all appear twice, overlapping, at a small vertical offset. This is a cascading-offset pattern consistent with a small per-line text/metric shift compounding down a long list of stacked rows, not different literal text content between expected and actual.
artifactInspection.assessment: HYPOTHESIS, NOT CONFIRMED: the pattern (isolated icon-level diffs on short/static views; cascading vertical text-position offsets on tall/list-heavy views; zero content substitution anywhere inspected; this is workflow run #1 for design-system.yml, i.e. these *-win32.png baselines had never previously been validated against a real GitHub Actions windows-latest runner) is most consistent with a font-rendering / line-height / DPI discrepancy between whichever machine originally captured these baselines (Plans 13-32/13-33/13-34, captured 2026-08-03 in this project's own executor worktrees, not verified to be genuinely pristine windows-latest GitHub Actions runners) and the actual clean windows-latest GitHub Actions image used by this run -- rather than 24 independent real visual regressions in the underlying UI code. This is an assessment based on the evidence inspected, not a proven root cause; it has NOT been verified by re-running capture on an actual windows-latest runner or by a controlled A/B rendering comparison, and it does not rule out a genuine regression as an alternative explanation.
artifactInspection.notInvestigated: No attempt was made to fix the baselines, regenerate them, or re-trigger a new run. No attempt was made to bisect which specific commit between baseline capture and this run introduced the discrepancy. That determination and any remediation (re-capturing baselines on a real windows-latest GitHub Actions runner, or a deeper diff-tooling investigation) is left to the orchestrator/user as a separate decision.
